response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced_amount FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), stats AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS avg_amount, SUM(invoiced_amount) AS grand_total FROM color_totals), shares AS (SELECT ct.color, ct.invoiced_amount, ct.invoiced_amount * 1.0 / s.grand_total AS share, s.avg_amount FROM color_totals ct CROSS JOIN stats s) SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(invoiced_amount - avg_amount) AS avg_above_average FROM shares WHERE invoiced_amount > avg_amount;
